description: Anonymized starter pack for newcomers. Import with: .\metra.ps1 import-profile -Path .\profiles\sample -Force
notes: Replace operator display name in .cursor/rules/metra-persona.local.mdc after import.
Edit metra.config.json roots and workspace.alwaysInclude for your machine.
Workspace outputs default to Metra.code-workspace with orchestration folder label Metra.
Personal-root registryFile (e.g. projects.personal.json beside personal projects) is not included in this pack; copy that file with the personal root separately if you use one.
